summary: Both changed files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. The HeckeRing file defines the HeckePair structure, double/left coset types (HeckeCoset, HeckeLeftCoset), the Hecke ring 𝕋 and module types as Finsupp over these cosets, and foundational lemmas on double coset decomposition and conjugation. The DimensionFormulas file provides transport equivalences between Γ(1) and mathlib's 𝒮ℒ notation, weight < 12 cusp form vanishing, the discriminant division isomorphism (CuspForm ≃ ModularForm), one-dimensionality of low even-weight spaces, and finite-dimensionality for arbitrary finite-index congruence subgroups via norm-reduction injection. Both are core number-theory formalizations with definitions, statements, and proofs.

summary: Inspected 15 representative files across the LeanModularForms project (main entry point, eigenforms, ForMathlib complex analysis, Hecke rings GL2/GLn, labels, modular forms, strong multiplicity one). All files except the root LeanModularForms.lean contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, lemmas with proofs covering Hecke algebras, modular forms, complex analysis (winding numbers, contour integrals, valence formula), eigenform theory, and LMFDB label construction. LeanModularForms.lean is a pure import aggregator (64 lines of only `public import` statements). Per FILTER-007, pure import aggregators are navigation data, but exclusion requires verifying the auxiliary search path exists — which cannot be confirmed here. Per FILTER-002 and FILTER-025, the default disposition is retain when uncertain. No file meets the hard-exclusion bar of FILTER-004 (no prover-aware check establishes absence of formal math; no duplicate representation exists).
